source.tier: STO Nett Rates - Great Plains' own trade-nett rate card (their term, 'STO Nett Rates', as printed in the filename/cover) - not necessarily the same STO ladder terminology used by Sunworld/Soroi; treat as this operator's own single nett tier, not mapped to Sunworld's 15-40% STO ladder.

seasonWindows.note: Season windows are NOT identical across all camps - Mara Plains and ol Donyo have a 3rd/different window boundary than the other Mara camps. Recorded per-camp below exactly as printed.

maraTotoTreeCamp.region: Maasai Mara National Reserve / Mara North Conservancy

maraExpeditionCamp.rooms: 5 Guest tents, 1 x 2-bedroom family tent + Pilot/guide tent
maraExpeditionCamp.region: Maasai Mara National Reserve / Mara North Conservancy

maasaiMaraReserveFee.unit: per night; subject to change without notice

maraNyikaCamp.rooms: 4 Guest Suites, 1 x 2-Bedroom Family Suite, 1 x 2-Bedroom Private Suite (The Sambuk Suite) + Pilot/guide tent
maraNyikaCamp.region: Naboisho Private Conservancy, Northern Maasai Mara

sambukSuiteExclusiveUsePerNight.note: Exclusive use only, incl. private vehicle+guide; accommodates 4 adults sharing or max 5 with children 6-15. No child rate or private vehicle surcharge applies (already included).

maraNyikaCamp.note: Every 3+ night stay includes one day's Maasai Mara National Reserve wildlife viewing; 1-2 night stays pay an additional Reserve entrance fee (amount not stated on this page).

maraPlainsCamp.rooms: 5 Guest Suites, 1 x 2-Bedroom Private Suite (The Jahazi Suite) + Pilot/guide tent
maraPlainsCamp.region: Olare Motorogi Private Conservancy, Northern Maasai Mara
maraPlainsCamp.note_seasons: This camp's shoulder window differs from Mara Toto/Mara Expedition/Mara Nyika (uses 01 Nov instead of 01 Oct as the shoulder start, and high season runs through 31 Oct instead of 30 Sep) - do not reuse another Mara camp's season dates for this one.

jahaziSuiteExclusiveUsePerNight.note: Exclusive use, incl. private vehicle+guide+pool; accommodates 4 adults sharing or max 5 with children. No child rate applies.

olDonyoLodge.rooms: 8 Deluxe Pool Suites, 1 x 2-Bedroom Sambu Suite + Pilot/guide room
olDonyoLodge.inclusionsNote: Includes a complimentary 15-min helicopter flight (new from Jan 2026, 1/stay, min 2-night stay, subject to availability) and Big Life conservation fees.

zamaraPrivate.note: First 12 guests' air transfers included in nightly rate; additional guests up to 16 (with children) charged separately for transfers. Kenya specific special offers (Stay4Pay3 etc.) NOT available at Zamara Private.

includedInNightlyRate: Nairobi Wilson <-> Mara Expedition/Nyika/Toto/Plains camps (and Sambuk/Jahazi suites)
ol Donyo Lodge <-> Mara camps (high season: 01 Jan-31 Mar, 16 Jun-31 Oct, 16-31 Dec 2026)

thirdPartyMaraPropertySurcharge.note: Applies when flying to/from third-party properties in the Maasai Mara

nairobiTransferRates2026.unit: per vehicle one-way, seating 1-4 guests, luxury vehicle

generalNotes.childPolicyPortfolioWide: Minimum age 6 years at all Kenya camps (differs from Soroi's 5-11 bracket entirely - Great Plains excludes under-6 outright rather than pricing them). Children 15 and younger must share with an adult; 16+ pay full adult rate in a separate room.
generalNotes.conservationLevyStructure: Single flat 'Great Plains Foundation Conservation & Community Contribution' of $100 per person (any age) per night, applied identically across every Kenya camp - simpler/flatter than any Soroi property's fee shape.
generalNotes.insuranceRequirement: Comprehensive travel/medical insurance (incl. Flying Doctors membership in Kenya where relevant) is a stated condition of travel, not optional.
generalNotes.specialOffers: Seasonal Stay4Pay3 / Stay8Pay6 / Honeymoon offers exist for the Mara camps and ol Donyo (not Zamara Private) - not itemized here as they are promotional, not base rate; see source pages 2-3 if needed for a specific quote.
